title: Cyber Shield: Network Defense
description: Defend your network against waves of cyber attacks! Deploy Firewalls, Antivirus software, Intrusion Detection Systems, and Encryption to stop malware, phishing attempts, DDoS attacks, and Advanced Persistent Threats. Learn real cybersecurity defense-in-depth strategies through gameplay.
learning_objectives: Understand cybersecurity defense layers and the defense-in-depth principle
Learn how firewalls, antivirus, and IDS protect networks from attacks
Recognize different cyber threat types: malware, phishing, DDoS, and APTs
Practice resource allocation in building a comprehensive security posture
Understand the role of encryption in protecting data and communications
Develop incident response thinking under pressure
how_to_play: Waves of cyber attacks (Malware, Phishing, DDoS, APTs) stream through your network toward critical systems.
Place security towers along the network path: Firewalls, Antivirus, IDS, and Encryption modules.
Each tower costs Budget to deploy — earn more by neutralizing threats.
Antivirus provides splash damage against malware clusters. Encryption slows down attacks for other defenses.
If too many attacks breach your network, your systems are compromised — game over!
Survive all 10 waves to achieve a fully secured network and win!

storybook_pages.title: Threat Detected
storybook_pages.text: Your organization's network is under siege. Hackers are launching coordinated attacks — malware payloads, sophisticated phishing campaigns, brute-force DDoS floods, and stealthy APTs. As the Chief Information Security Officer, you must deploy your security budget to build an impenetrable defense.
storybook_pages.image_prompt: corporate network operations center with multiple screens showing threat maps, red alert warnings, a CISO at the command desk, digital threat icons approaching a network diagram, dark cyberpunk cartoon style

storybook_pages.title: Defense in Depth
storybook_pages.text: No single tool stops all attacks. Firewalls block known threats at the perimeter. Antivirus catches malware that slips through. IDS monitors for suspicious patterns from a distance. Encryption scrambles data so even intercepted traffic is useless. Layer your defenses wisely.
storybook_pages.image_prompt: layered defense diagram with four security tools as tower characters: a brick wall (firewall), a shield with checkmark (antivirus), a radar dish (IDS), a padlock (encryption), each on a different defense layer, technical cartoon style

storybook_pages.title: Network Secured
storybook_pages.text: After surviving every wave of attacks, your network stands strong. Each layer of defense played its part. You've learned that cybersecurity isn't about one magic solution — it's about strategic layers, constant vigilance, and smart resource allocation.
storybook_pages.image_prompt: secure network glowing green with shields and locks, defeated cyber threats dissolving into pixels, team of security professionals celebrating, digital certificates and award badges, triumphant cartoon style

rounds.coaching_moment: Think carefully about the trade-offs before committing to this path.
rounds.reflection_prompt: Why did you make this choice?

transfer_exercises.game_context: Prioritizing which threats to defend against first
transfer_exercises.real_world: Triaging tasks and problems by impact and urgency
transfer_exercises.challenge: Use the Eisenhower matrix to categorize your current tasks. Are you spending time on what actually matters?

transfer_exercises.real_world: Keeping quality high when workload unexpectedly doubles
transfer_exercises.challenge: Design a personal 'defense system' — habits and routines that protect your performance under stress.

glossary_terms.definition: The process of selecting among alternatives based on available information and values.
glossary_terms.example: Choosing between two career paths based on income, passion, and long-term growth.
glossary_terms.deep_dive: Good decision-making combines rational analysis with awareness of cognitive biases that distort judgment.
glossary_terms.real_world_example: Leaders make high-stakes decisions daily — the quality of their process matters as much as the decision itself.

glossary_terms.definition: Analyzing information objectively to form a well-reasoned judgment.
glossary_terms.example: Questioning whether a statistic is representative before using it to make a decision.
glossary_terms.deep_dive: Critical thinking involves identifying assumptions, evaluating evidence, and considering alternative perspectives.
glossary_terms.real_world_example: Journalists fact-check before publishing; scientists replicate experiments before claiming discoveries.

glossary_terms.definition: The belief that abilities can be developed through effort and learning from failure.
glossary_terms.example: Seeing a poor game result as feedback on what to practice, not evidence of being bad at the game.
glossary_terms.deep_dive: Research by Carol Dweck shows people with growth mindsets achieve more and recover better from setbacks.
glossary_terms.real_world_example: Students who believe intelligence is fixed give up when challenged; those with growth mindset persist and improve.

cultural_context: India's Digital India initiative has made cybersecurity a national priority. With India ranking among the top-5 most cyber-attacked nations globally, building a security-aware mindset among students is increasingly urgent.
reflection_prompt: Where did your defenses bend before they broke? What would you reinforce first next time?
